description: Defines a custom attribute 'EndpointAttribute' used for marking or annotating endpoints within the BlazorShared.Attributes namespace.

classes.name: EndpointAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class used to associate a name with an endpoint, inherits from System.Attribute.

methods.name: set_Name
methods.description: Setter for the 'Name' property of the EndpointAttribute, allowing assignment of endpoint name.

methods.name: get_Name
methods.description: Getter for the 'Name' property of the EndpointAttribute, retrieving the assigned endpoint name.
